# Rida Naz - Agentic AI Engineer & Full Stack Product Builder

## About
Rida Naz is a Full Stack Developer and Agentic AI Engineer based in Karachi, Pakistan.
She builds production AI systems, voice AI agents, agentic workflows, RAG knowledge systems, and full stack SaaS platforms for founders, startups, and technical teams.

## Current Role
Founding team member and Lead Engineer at TalkifAI, an AI voice agent platform.
Her work includes LiveKit voice infrastructure, SIP/WebRTC pipelines, BYOC telephony, backend APIs, RAG knowledge bases, and scalable deployment.

## Core Expertise
- Voice AI agents and realtime communication
- Agentic workflows and tool-using AI systems
- RAG knowledge systems and AI assistants
- Full stack SaaS platforms
- FastAPI, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Docker, and Google Cloud
- LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP, LiveKit, Twilio, and Telnyx
- Agentic SEO, structured metadata, and AI-readable content architecture

## Services
- Voice AI agent build
- Agentic workflow automation
- RAG knowledge assistant development
- Full stack AI SaaS MVP development
- AI integration layers for APIs, tools, and business systems
- Agentic SEO and AI visibility

## Featured Projects
- [TalkifAI](https://talkifai.dev): AI voice agent platform with LiveKit, SIP, BYOC telephony, RAG workflows, and multi-tenant infrastructure.
- [AI Native Book](https://ainative-book.ridanaz.com): Physical AI and humanoid robotics textbook with integrated RAG chatbot.
- [Agentic Todo](https://agentic-todo.ridanaz.com): MCP-powered full stack task management app with natural language workflows.
